slot: personal file storage + backup (separate from company)

pick.name: Google Drive (personal account, AI Pro storage) used via the personal browser profile
pick.what: Personal cloud storage bundled with your Google AI Pro plan
pick.why: Already paid for, large quota, Gemini works across Drive, and using it in a personal browser profile avoids installing personal sync clients on a work laptop
pick.free_limits: Google AI Pro page lists 5 TB shared across Photos/Drive/Gmail (promo/free-until-2028 plan quota not verified)

alts.name: Kopia
alts.what: Encrypted, deduplicated, versioned backup with Windows GUI
alts.why: Best free backup for anything that must exist only on your machine (e.g. Obsidian vault, code not yet pushed): encrypt and push to R2/B2 or Drive via rclone
alts.free_limits: Free; storage cost is your backend's

alts.name: Syncthing
alts.what: Peer-to-peer folder sync between laptop and phone, no cloud
alts.why: Best for laptop<->Android sync of the notes vault; Android via Syncthing-Fork (researchxxl)

candidates.name: Google Drive (personal)
candidates.verdict: PICK: owned, huge quota, browser-only keeps separation

candidates.name: Kopia
candidates.verdict: Encrypted versioned backups; use for local-only folders

candidates.name: Syncthing
candidates.verdict: Laptop<->phone without cloud; official Android app retired 2024, fork maintained

candidates.name: OneDrive personal
candidates.verdict: 5 GB free; confusing next to the company OneDrive client

candidates.name: restic
candidates.verdict: Excellent CLI backup (0.19.1 2026-07-05) but no GUI; Kopia easier

candidates.name: rclone
candidates.verdict: Swiss-army sync tool (v1.75.2); use under Kopia, not alone

candidates.name: Dropbox / Proton Drive
candidates.verdict: Small free quotas; not verified this pass

decision: Keep personal data in personal cloud (Google Drive via the personal browser profile, code in private GitHub repos) so a work laptop holds as little personal data as possible and can be wiped without loss. Add Kopia only for folders that must live locally, and Syncthing only for the notes vault to phone. Check company IT policy before installing Drive for desktop or Syncthing on a managed device.
details: On a company-managed device, IT may be able to see or wipe local files. Never mix client/company data into personal storage.

verify.note: Google plan pages list AI Pro at 5 TB (upgraded from 2 TB, no price change); promotional plans may differ.
